# Plays of the images larger than 512 KiB, in the format of panel.txt (bank
# traffic of step 16.0: SIMBANKLOG and banks.py; see README.md). The model
# reads their banks into a bank cache as the console does (step 16.2), e.g.
#
#   tools/arm60model/batch.py -panel tools/arm60model/panel_large.txt \
#       -only virtua_fighter_animation-u -reports DIR
#
# (-simargs "-whole -dramfree 1600000": the image in one block, as before).
#
# The scripts are written by hand, not recorded: Virtua Fighter Animation
# (1 MiB, 64 banks), story mode (Akira against Pai, three rounds, then the
# continue screen and the title). The second line, commented, is a play
# in the VS COM mode (Kage against Jacky on another stage, three rounds):
# copy its script into SIMPAD to run it.
#
# The Lost World: Jurassic Park (Game Gear, 1 MiB, eight blank banks): the
# Brachiosaurus mission chosen on the map, its scrolling stage (frames
# 2 250-3 850), game over, the title and the demo play (5 900-6 850). The
# second line, commented: the Baryonyx mission, its stage (2 350 on), the
# player held at a tree from frame 3 000 to the end.
#
# Sonic Blast (Master System conversion, 1 MiB, in takeme/roms/Master_System):
# Sonic, the first act (frames
# 1 350-4 000), then the bonus stage (4 020-8 400). The second line, commented: Knuckles,
# the first act (1 450-2 900), then held at a loop to the end.
#
# Street Fighter II (Master System, 800 KiB, 50 banks, in
# takeme/roms/Master_System):
# a play recorded on Phoenix (3 294 frames, no disc read with 32 buffers).
#
# The lines marked "Phoenix" are plays recorded on Phoenix with the
# bank cache of 32 buffers, those marked "Phoenix, 40 buffers" with 32
# buffers in VRAM and 8 in DRAM; they replay hash for hash with either
# layout, with the same disc reads at the same frames as on Phoenix
# (copy a script into SIMPAD to run it).
#
# cartridge                       frames  pad script
